annotations.label: T cells (CD4-like predominant; naive/memory split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D and CD3E are enriched, with detection 88% and 77%. IL7R is detected in 66% of cells and CD8A in 12%, which suggests CD4-predominant T cells (inference). CCR7 is detected in 36%. The retrieved abstracts support CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes but not LDHB. Naive versus memory is not resolved at this resolution.

annotations.label: Monocytes (CD14+ and FCGR3A+ likely mixed)
annotations.notes: Computed: these myeloid genes are strongly enriched, and LYZ is detected in 99% of cells. CD14 is detected in 53% and FCGR3A in 34%, so classical and non-classical monocytes may be merged. Evidence gap: no retrieved abstract links these specific genes to monocytes, so confidence stays uncertain despite the strong computed signal.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic lymphocytes (NK cells and CD8+ effector T cells, mixed)
annotations.notes: Computed: cytotoxic genes are enriched, and NKG7 is detected in 99.8% of cells. CD3D is detected in 60%, CD8A in 36% and KLRF1 in 12%, so NK and CD8 T cells are probably mixed. NCAM1 is low. The abstracts support NKG7/GNLY/PRF/GZMB as cytotoxic markers, not an NK versus T split. Split not resolved.

annotations.label: B cells
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A, MS4A1 and CD79B are strongly enriched, together with MHC class II genes. TCL1A and FCER2 suggest a naive-like B subset (inference, not tested). PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in a CLL context, so scope is limited. Distinct UMAP island.

annotations.label: Dendritic cells (CD1C+ cDC-like; pDC admixture possible)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A is detected in 83% of cells and CLEC10A in 69%, both strongly enriched. CD1C is detected in 50%. The cluster has 36 cells. CLEC4C and SERPINF1 appear in a minority of cells, so pDCs may be mixed in. Support is one tumor scRNA abstract naming FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs. Marker overlap is partial, so confidence is tentative.
